challenge.method: Tested two eligible candidates, failure within the chosen body, a suspended alternative, and the sequential clause-search operator on printed p. 299.
challenge.results: The authors mention practical selection of the first candidate found and describe a clause-search control that can delay trying a later clause. Neither narrows the frozen claim's statement about an available candidate or introduces backtracking over the chosen clause. Section 1.1.2 distinguishes suspension from failed candidacy.

limitations: The reviewed rule belongs to the discussed and-parallel subset. It does not establish a mandatory candidate tie-break, a scheduling algorithm, or the excluded or-parallel behavior.
